query: How do reasons for visit relate to urgency and visit duration across department and age group?

per_column.name: symptom_acuity
per_column.rationale: Acuity timeframe is a strong new axis for relating reasons to urgency and duration. Values are well-grounded in text cues (e.g. 'x3 days'->acute, 'follow-up 6 months'->chronic). Acne case labeled chronic is defensible.

per_column.name: clinical_instability_present
per_column.rationale: Instability is a useful urgency-adjacent axis. Sampled rows correctly read as stable given reassuring findings. Grounded, though inherently inferential.

per_column.name: diagnostic_intervention_intensity
per_column.rationale: Workup intensity plausibly correlates with duration; useful. Mostly grounded (labs/imaging explicitly mentioned), but acne row with prescriptions labeled 'no_diagnostic_action' is technically consistent since no tests were ordered.

per_column.name: primary_organ_system
per_column.rationale: Organ system gives good grouping leverage for reasons. Most values sound, but the MI follow-up (clearly cardiovascular) is fine; the annual physical labeled 'endocrine' is a stretch given only HbA1c ordered — a warranted-but-thin inference.

per_column.name: multi_system_involvement
per_column.rationale: Could add nuance, but a mostly-binary flag with limited leverage. The cardiac follow-up marked multi_system=True is not supported by the text (single cardiovascular focus), indicating some ungrounded assertions.

per_column.name: visit_reason_category
per_column.rationale: Directly operationalizes 'reasons for visit' — the core query axis. Values well-grounded, though labeling acne (chronic condition, no flare stated) as 'acute_exacerbation_chronic' is a mild mismatch.

per_column.name: chronic_disease_component
per_column.rationale: Reasonable grouping axis but partly redundant with symptom_acuity and visit_reason_category. Grounded overall, though acne (a chronic skin condition) marked False is questionable.

per_column.name: intervention_required
per_column.rationale: Management type is a useful axis plausibly tied to duration. Sampled values largely match text (med initiation, conservative care). Grounded and non-trivial.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide several genuinely useful new axes (acuity, reason category, organ system, intervention, workup intensity) that directly support relating reasons to urgency and duration across department/age. Values are mostly sound readings of the source text with sensible categorisation. Groundedness is slightly reduced by a few over-confident inferences: multi_system_involvement asserts True for a single-system cardiac case, and the 'endocrine' organ-system label for a general physical is thin. A couple of columns (chronic_disease_component, multi_system_involvement) offer weaker/partly redundant leverage. Overall a high-quality augmentation with minor grounding lapses.
